name: moving-border
blurb: Animated gradient border loops around button.
description: A button with a continuously rotating conic-gradient border using Framer Motion, wrapped with a visible animated ring effect.
use_when: You need an attention-grabbing CTA with constant border motion.
avoid_when: On minimalist interfaces; the continuous motion can feel excessive.
a11y: Standard button semantics. Border animation is visual only. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
